request.style: English, solo male voice, warm and gentle, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, light percussion, folk, contemplative, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In holiness and righteousness we walk
Before him all our days we shall keep
You child will be called a prophet
Of the Most High in your sacred sleep

[Chorus]
Dawn from on high will visit us
Shine on those in darkness and the shadow of death
Guide our feet into the way of peace
With the tender mercy of our God

[Verse]
Prepare his ways to go on ahead
Give his people knowledge of salvation
Through the forgiveness of their sins
In the wilderness you grew strong in spirit

[Chorus]
Dawn from on high will visit us
Shine on those in darkness and the shadow of death
Guide our feet into the way of peace
With the tender mercy of our God

[Bridge]
Until the day you appeared publicly
To Israel in the light of day
Strong in spirit and guided by grace
Walking the path of peace and truth

[Chorus]
Dawn from on high will visit us
Shine on those in darkness and the shadow of death
Guide our feet into the way of peace
With the tender mercy of our God

[Outro]
Dawn from on high to shine on us
In the way of peace forevermore
